bbb_reviews.text: The service was mediocre but the part that upset me was the $525 bill I received after the services. Months later I receive a text and email stating I owe $525 when we haven't been to the dentist since this incident. I get text and emails once a week regarding this matter harassing me. I even received one this past Monday saying "thank you for your visit, you now have a balance of $525". We didn't visit the Super Dentist Monday. This is unacceptable!

As a parent this place made me feel like I had hurt my own children by bringing them here.

No stars by far the worst business in existence for dentistry. I'm very unhappy and wish I had never walked into their office on Aero Dr. **** practice debt collection at the front desk in front of everyone. **** keep you from getting care until you pay off your balance!

Then upon inquiring the cost, I learned they were going to up charge over $600 in unnecessary extra cleanings and toothpastes.I sent the **rays to my trusted dentist who was horrified to hear, but not surprised, of my experience. After inspecting the **rays they determined a couple cavities and no crowns were necessary.This place is willing to put your kids through unnecessary pain and trauma to rake in their bottom line-cash.Avoid at all costs!!!!Its a cute office but not worth the terror, price, and health impacts of unnecessary and over zealous treatment plans would cause to you and your children.

No communication from the doctors. What was supposed to be a routine cleaning visit ended up being a nightmare and now my child has silver crown that were not authorized. If a child "needs" a treatment that is so invasive the least they can do is explain to parents the procedure and offer options. There was no after care summary or anything in writing that explained that my child needed silver crowns. The doctor barely made eye contact during our visit and never explained her treatment recommendations. They do nothing to solve problems and communication is the worst. After the incident I had other dentists look at my child's x-rays and they agreed silver crown was not the primary solution. Please do not bring your children here, save yourself the stress from unnecessary dental procedures and poor ethics.

Give them one star due to great service while I was active duty and flexible hours. Since I retired and changed my insurance they have been trying to charge me left and right and add services my three kids dont need. Also the place feels like an assembly line, not some where you want to take your kids for a pleasant dental visit. Forms, forms and more forms, every time you come for a cleaning you have to fill out the same forms you had completed the last time. Like you are a new patient. Completely ridiculous and unnecessary to say the least.

CROOKS!  I have to agree with previous comments on this place billing for unnecessary procedures like putting sealants on baby teeth that were about to fall out.  We moved to the area recently and have been looking for good dentists to take our daughters to.  This place had a lot of good reviews--they seem to cater to the "experience" of taking your kids to the dentist, but miss the entire point of going to the dentist in the first place--good dental care.  Overall it was unprofessional and disorganized.  We have good dental PPO insurance and what was supposed to be a preventative visit and routine cleaning that should have been covered by our insurance, we were billed a total of $400 for our two kids for services that were not authorized. The most expensive of which was applying sealants to all of their teeth, the majority of which were baby teeth.   We tried calling the office several times, and of course the billing office can't help and don't communicate with the clinical staff, so no one has answers as to what happened.  GET THIS, several months later we find another dentist recommended by a friend, and on our kids follow up exam finds NO EVIDENCE OF SEALANTS.  LONG STORY SHORT--if you want your kids to have a 'fun' experience at the dentist but don't mind paying a lot of money for sub par (or in our case, not sure if anything other than a cleaning was done) dental care, then go to the Super Dentist.  If you want good dental care, we would recommend going to the smaller practices that aren't like these larger impersonable businesses (and it is a business to them at the end of the day, they made that very clear)--not the type of place that is passionate about taking care of your kids and doing whats best.
